_comment: Rules are tried in order on the mail subject. First match wins. 'result' group text is mapped by result_map (case-insensitive regex -> Success/Warning/Failed). Test every new rule with: int-bkp-mail-parser.py --test-subject '<subject>'

rules.name: Synology Hyper Backup / Active Backup for Business (English)
rules.subject: (?i)(?:backup|restore|copy) task\s+\[?(?P<job>.+?)\]?\s+(?:on\s+\S+\s+)?(?:has\s+|was\s+|is\s+)?(?P<result>partially completed|completed with warnings|completed with errors|successfully completed|completed|succeeded|finished|failed|was cancelled|cancelled|canceled|aborted)\b

rules.name: Synology Hyper Backup / Active Backup for Business (Czech)
rules.subject: (?i)úloha\s+(?:zálohování\s+)?\[?(?P<job>.+?)\]?\s+(?:na\s+\S+\s+)?(?:byla\s+)?(?P<result>částečně dokončena|úspěšně dokončena|dokončena|selhala|zrušena)\b
